old_str: - **In Bangladesh:** no one may leave Bangladesh without a valid passport, and doing so carries up to three months in jail, a fine of up to Tk 500, or both (see Cases at home) [OI0082, OI0083].
new_str: - **In Bangladesh:** no one may leave Bangladesh without a valid passport, and doing so carries up to six months in jail, a fine of up to Tk 2,000, or both (see Cases at home) [OI0082, OI0107].
problem: Wrong penalty. OI0083 quotes Article 11(3) of the Passport Order 1973 (three months, Tk 500), which applies only where 'no punishment is provided elsewhere'; Article 11(1)(a) of the saved source (bd-passport-order-1973.md) punishes contravening Article 3 (departing without a valid passport) with up to six months or a fine up to Taka two thousand, or both. Log a new fact for Article 11(1)(a) and cite it here; remove or correct OI0083.

old_str: - **The offence:** the Bangladesh Passport Order 1973 bars anyone from leaving Bangladesh without a valid passport, and breaking it carries up to three months in jail, a fine of up to Tk 500, or both [OI0082, OI0083].

problem: Same error as in What the law says: Article 11(1)(a) of the Passport Order sets six months / Tk 2,000 for contravening Article 3; OI0083 (Article 11(3), three months / Tk 500) is the residual penalty and does not apply. Needs a new fact for Article 11(1)(a).
